Breadth-first walk of the Amazon Books bestseller taxonomy: root plus its 35 child categories, with slack for retries. Measures the distribution of rating counts among ranked titles as a competition signal. Concludes nothing about demand.
Diagnose why subcategory requests returned browse-like listings instead of bestseller charts: re-read the root for child urls, then re-request two children by url instead of by numeric id.
